Project Report

• Name of the Project: Terracotta Ganesha idol making
• ⁠Name of the Club: Rotary Club of Mumbai Kalakar
• ⁠Where: Regional Mental Hospital Thane
• ⁠For Whom: Female Patients of the hospital
• ⁠Number of beneficiaries: 25
• ⁠Cost of the Project: ₹1275
• ⁠Avenue: Vocational
• ⁠Name of the Club President: Rtn Suparna Chakravarty Mukherjee
• ⁠Project Chair: Rtn PP Haima Deshpande
• ⁠Project Brief: Facilitator Sonali Bijur, a Rotarian from Dist 3142 conducted the workshop wherein she took the female patients through the art of Ganesha idol making.
Using terracotta clay as the medium, Sonali guided them to make their own idols. Many of these participants said that it was a thoroughly enjoyable activity.
location: Regional mantal hospital, Thane, Mumbai, Maharashtra
